title: తొంభై heard as తొమ్మిది
hint: Telugu: ninety thousand, and a mobile number
say: eight two one one, zero five six, eight three eight కి phone చేయండి, తొంభై వేల రూపాయల గురించి.
note: తొంభై (ninety) and తొమ్మిది (nine) differ by a syllable. The model logs nine thousand; four recogniser families and the Telugu acoustic model say ninety.

title: A Telugu half, lost
say: ఎనిమిదిన్నర లక్షల రూపాయలు COD, cash ready గా ఉంచండి.
note: In Telugu the half is a suffix on the multiplier: ఎనిమిది + న్నర is eight and a half. The model alone keeps only the lakh.

title: A number read in Telugu digits
hint: Telugu: ఆరు and ఏడు, six and seven
say: callback number ఆరు ఏడు ఆరు ఎనిమిది, డబుల్ ఆరు జీరో, ఏడు జీరో ఆరు.
note: Sixes and sevens with a doubled digit. The model alone gets several digits wrong; the digit grammar scores the exact ten digits against the audio.

title: A dropped ఇరవై
hint: Telugu-English: a number, then an amount
say: seven one double two, six one six, one three eight కి phone చేయండి, ఇరవై రెండు వేల ఐదు వందల రూపాయల గురించి.
note: The model drops the first word of the amount and logs two thousand five hundred instead of twenty-two thousand five hundred.
